facts.fact: Universal Ads will serve as the exclusive ads manager for NBCUniversal's coverage of the Milan Cortina 2026 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games.
facts.quote: For the first time, Universal Ads will serve as the exclusive ads manager for NBCU’s coverage of the Milan Cortina 2026 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games

facts.fact: The 2024 Paris Olympic Games drove 23B+ streaming minutes of Olympic programming across Peacock and NBCU platforms, according to the vendor's post.
facts.quote: the 2024 Paris Olympic Games driving **23B+ streaming minutes** of Olympic programming across Peacock and NBCU platforms.

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that brands can buy NBCU Olympic inventory without upfront commitments or minimum spend requirements.
facts.quote: brands can tap into this cultural moment without upfront commitments or minimum spend requirements

facts.fact: Universal Ads states that brands of any size can secure premium Olympic inventory without upfronts or minimums for the Milan Cortina 2026 Games.
facts.quote: for the first time, brands of any size can secure premium Olympic inventory without upfronts or minimums

facts.fact: Universal Ads gives advertisers access to NBCU's Olympic inventory including live coverage, full event replay, and highlights and short-form content.
facts.quote: Universal Ads gives advertisers full access to NBCU’s Olympic inventory, including live coverage, full event replay, and highlights & short-form content.

facts.fact: The blog post was published on December 17, 2025, with a page metadata published time of 2026-09-15.
